strings.name: Martin Sorrell
strings.role: Founder and Executive Chairman of S4Capital; former WPP CEO
strings.summary: Martin Sorrell is a British advertising entrepreneur who helped develop WPP into a multinational marketing services group through acquisitions and business integration. After leaving WPP in 2018, he founded S4Capital, focusing on digital advertising, data and technology services. His career connects traditional advertising group expansion with the transition to digital marketing.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through 17 November 2026. Distinguishes the 1985 investment from the 1986 CEO appointment, S4Capital's founding from appointment to the listed company's board, and departure-related allegations from established findings.
strings.influence.rationale: Developed WPP and founded S4 Capital, advancing global advertising, marketing services and digital communications businesses.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Studied economics at Christ's College, Cambridge, and earned a Harvard Business School MBA in 1968; an Honorary Fellow of Christ's since 2017.
strings.facts.f2.label: Current role
strings.facts.f2.value: Founder and Executive Chairman of S4Capital, which operates under the Monks brand; WPP CEO is a former role.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Expanding an advertising group through acquisitions
strings.highlights.h1.text: During his leadership of WPP, the group acquired companies including JWT and Ogilvy, extending its advertising and marketing services network.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Starting a new digital marketing business
strings.highlights.h2.text: Founded S4Capital in 2018, combining with MediaMonks and MightyHive that year; the business later operated under the Monks brand.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Discussing digital marketing in Shanghai
strings.timeline.t1.text: Gave an interview during the International Business Leaders' Advisory Council meeting for the Mayor of Shanghai, setting out his views on AI and international marketing.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Founding S4Capital
strings.timeline.t2.text: The company's history dates its formation and initial funding to May; his appointment to the listed company's board was on 28 September.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Leaving WPP
strings.timeline.t3.text: Resigned as CEO with immediate effect following a company investigation into allegations of personal misconduct; he denied wrongdoing, and the announcement did not disclose the investigation's details.
strings.timeline.t4.title: WPP acquires Ogilvy
strings.timeline.t4.text: The group acquired Ogilvy Group, expanding its international advertising business.
strings.timeline.t5.title: WPP acquires JWT
strings.timeline.t5.text: The group acquired JWT Group, an important step in expanding its advertising operations.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Becoming WPP CEO
strings.timeline.t6.text: Joined the board and became group CEO that year, distinct from the investment the previous year.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Investing in WPP
strings.timeline.t7.text: Invested in a business that had made wire and plastic products, helping redirect it toward marketing services.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Earning a Harvard MBA
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed an MBA at Harvard Business School after studying economics at Cambridge.
